title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Naya Note

source.path: Naya Power Smart Brain v3 Hardening execution on 2026-08-25

summary: The Smart Brain hardening pass turns the memory architecture into an enforced operating system: deterministic indexes, executable CI validation, reliable tests, hybrid retrieval, verified CIS artifacts, and explicit evidence boundaries.
what_happened: The Superbrain hardening pass converted constitutional memory rules into executable runtime and CI boundaries while preserving canonical events as source truth.
what_we_learned: A constitution becomes operational only when code and CI enforce it.
Derived indexes must be deterministic so repository state can be proven clean.
Verification must be stronger than confidence: repair data and validators rather than weakening the gate.
Canonical events are source truth; indexes are derived views; receipts are evidence.
why_it_matters: The system can now prove important memory, continuity, retrieval, and verification behavior rather than merely documenting intended behavior.
what_changed: Established deterministic Superbrain validation and indexing.
Added executable continuity and project contracts.
Added idempotency, resolution, supersession, outbox, health, retrieval baseline, and CIS acceptance slices.
next_best_action: Harden automated entity resolution and contradiction/supersession, then advance semantic retrieval and measurable CIS compounding without disturbing the verified foundation.
content: The Superbrain must enforce its laws in code and CI, preserve canonical history, and leave evidence and learning for the next Naya.
